text:
elena: FYI starting a POC with StrataWorks (healthtech) — they want SSO + SCIM provisioning + RBAC mapping + strict domain controls. Asking for next-steps for technical presales and pricing. Their main blockers: data residency (CA), enterprise SAML with role assertions, SCIM delta support, and a security questionnaire attached. Can we coordinate?

rick: I can drive the config side. Need to confirm IdP (Okta/ADFS) and which SAML attributes they send. Also we should collect the role matrix for RBAC -> Sales needs to ask StrataWorks for that.

elena: they said Okta + some on-prem ADFS. Also asked about Dedicated/Private pricing for a 3-node pool and whether tenant locking (domain ownership) can be enforced.

maya: SAML stuff — give them these example values and ask for their metadata XML:
```
Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs/strataworks
Entity ID: https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata
NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
Requested attributes: email, givenName, familyName, groups, roles
```
SCIM mapping snippet (tell them we support standard 2.0 attributes + custom role mapping):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "user@example.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "First","familyName": "Last"},
  "active": true,
  "groups": ["id-of-group-1"],
  "urn:custom:roles": ["editor","admin"]
}
```

rick: For RBAC we can map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles. Ask them to send a CSV: local_role,scim_group,redwood_role. We'll validate during the POC and provide mapping script.

jas: Security checklist: we need the completed vendor security questionnaire (please attach). Key asks from us to them: encryption at rest (KMS), key control (customer-managed KMS?), pen test history, SOC2/ISO copies, and data residency/backup locations. Also flag: if they require HSM-backed keys for private deployment, that adds infra lead time.

noah-legal: We'll need the DPA + data flow diagram before Dedicated procurement. If they insist on private control plane, legal will expect SOC2 + contractual SLAs.

elena: schedule-wise — customer wants a demo + validation next Wed. Can we have working SAML + SCIM test by then?

rick: Possible if we get their IdP metadata by EOD tomorrow. I can spin up a test tenant and enable SCIM delta and a sample RBAC map.

maya: Note on domain proofing/tenant lock: we support DNS TXT verification for domain ownership and an optional email allowlist for tenant auto-claim. For strict tenant lock we require either DNS TXT proof or a verified admin email on the org domain. Sample DNS TXT:
```
_redwood-verification.strataworks.com TXT "redwood=83a4b2"
```

elena: pricing question from procurement: they want committed monthly price for 3-node Dedicated (NVIDIA A40-ish), 99.9% SLA, plus 30% discount for 12mo commit. Any ballpark?

rick: Ballpark for committed 3-node pool + managed infra + 99.9% SLA: "$15,000/mo" pre-discount. With 12mo commit and enterprise support add-on, expect around "$10,500/mo" after negotiated discount. Highlight: network egress and storage backups billed separately.

elena: perfect. I'll send that as a rough estimate and mark as indicative pending final sizing. Also attaching their security questionnaire (see thread attachment) — @jas please start filling.

jas: Will start now. Quick Q: do they require SCIM event delivery SLA (e.g., guaranteed <5s)? If so that's a product-level ask — might need to call out caveats on delta/bulk throughput.

rick: We support best-effort near-real-time SCIM delta; for guaranteed sub-5s you'll need Dedicated with strong autoscaling and batching tuned. I'll note caveat in the answer.

deploy-bot: reminder — create test tenant `strataworks-poc-1717` and enable feature flag `scim-delta`.

elena: Thanks all — action items: (1) I'll request IdP metadata + role matrix + completed questionnaire (2) @rick create test tenant and prepare demo scripts (3) @jas start security answers + flag HSM/DPA items (4) @noah-legal checklist DPA/SOC2. Back to you when I have metadata. :thumbsup:
